games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Music plays on your phone too, not just the TV
Skaters now move with real motion-captured animation
Goalies use hand-posed saves: pads, glove, blocker and smothers
Fight mode: drop the gloves and use the round thumb pad to jab, grab and dodge
Slow-mo replays after goals, plus a highlight reel at the end
Watch AI vs AI: sit back and let the computer play both teams
A pregame intro: players skate out and the anthem plays (tap to skip)
Content modes: everyone picks a family-friendly level and the game plays at the cleanest one in the room
Phone scores now count on the shared scoreboard
Big hits can knock a player's helmet and stick flying
The puck is back to full size
Heads up: the goalies are tough right now. Scoring is still being tweaked and balanced, so tell us how it feels!

games.name: Orbit Brawl
new: Phone cockpit space dogfight: fly and shoot from your phone, play bots solo
Put it on a screen and friends scan the QR to join as pilots
Phone / Screen switch and ? help in the top corner
